step.cmd: Client connects to the shared printer on the server.
Server sends driver details to the client.
Client checks whether it has the necessary HP v4 driver.
If not found in local store, client uses Windows Update to fetch the HP v4 driver.
If Windows Update is unavailable, client prompts user to provide the HP v4 driver manually.
Once the HP v4 driver is installed, client uses Windows Update to fetch any necessary printer extensions and PDFs.
